functions.name: sin
functions.caption: sine, of an angle in radians

functions.name: cos
functions.caption: cosine, of an angle in radians

functions.name: log
functions.caption: natural logarithm, the inverse of exp

functions.name: less
functions.caption: 1 where the first is below the second, else 0: a step that composes by multiplication

operators.caption: sum and difference, read left to right: a - b - c is (a - b) - c
product and quotient, tighter than a sum, read left to right
a product may leave out its * after a number or a closing parenthesis, not after a name
minus, tighter than a product and looser than a power: -x^2 is -(x^2)
a whole power n from 1 to 64; a^b for another b is exp(b * log(a))
an equation in one unknown, solved for it

constants.name: nan
constants.caption: not a number: what a function gives outside its domain

questions.caption: an equation in one unknown of degree at most two, solved in closed form with its steps and checked by Vieta's formulas

questions.form: solve f = g for x in [a, b], p in [c, d]
questions.caption: the root on [a, b] as a function of the parameter p, synthesised and certified
questions.example: solve x^2 - p = 0 for x in [0, 10], p in [0.5, 4]

questions.form: integrate f for t in [a, b], p in [c, d]
questions.caption: the integral as a function of p; a limit may be p itself
questions.example: integrate sin(t)/t for t in [0, x], x in [0.5, 6]
